conventions.indexing: All frame and anchor indices are zero-based; descriptions describe held image poses, never substitute movement of a duplicate drawing.
conventions.facing: World target is screen RIGHT and camera is fixed. Face right in three-quarter view except explicitly described 360 rotations or reverse finishes. Do not mirror alternate frames to simulate action.
conventions.staging: One frame-sheet contains the same named frame for all35 captains in exact7columns×5rows, using original captain reference order. Full bodies inside their cells, transparent padding, no ball/rim/text/grid/floor/shadow. Keep original scale and cell baseline across all frames of a clip; airborne height is applied by runtime z, so do not move whole artwork upward to fake ascent.
conventions.ball: All ball mentions specify empty hand/paw/tail positions around the simulation-rendered invisible ball. Draw NO basketball. Before release anchor, hands grip; release-frame fingers visibly open; following frames have empty follow-through. Before grab anchor palms/tail are open; grab frame closes; subsequent pose protects possession.
conventions.loops: Idle uses explicit ping-pong sequence from metadata. Draw its six distinct stages once. Other looping clips connect final pose to first without repeating the first drawing. Nonloop clips have clear startup, active action, recovery; anchors must never shift.
conventions.dunks: Eight named dunk variants plus two alley-oop variants each have15 independently authored poses. Takeoff2/grab5/peak7/release10/finish11/land14. In ordinary dunks grab5 means securing an already-carried ball, not catching a new pass; in alley-oops it is actual incoming catch. Never release during a fake pump.
conventions.generationStatus: Catalog is a production recipe. Existing source jobs and reviewed manifests alone establish completed art; an entry here is not completed artwork.

canonicalCorrections.priority: Canonical master descriptions below override erroneous source-reference details, while preserving each identity and existing jersey palette. Do not invent permanent species/features to rationalize an error.
mustCorrect: Manaconda: real driftwood grows from both temples compactly BACKWARD hugging skull, with small blossoms; never upright crown/antlers or forehead branches. Salt-and-pepper beard and deep-blue rectangular glasses mandatory.

Keeg: BLACK hair and short trimmed BLACK beard, tall ornate PURPLE witch hat with SILVER trim and mushrooms. Existing reference white beard and red toadstool cap are canonical errors, do not propagate.
Lavi: woman with SHORT ginger curls, freckles, green eyes, silver glasses and rainbow shoe laces; existing longer hair must be shortened.
Leo: pale adult man with long wavy BLACK hair and refined mustache; black/crimson adaptation, no generic purple-gold male replacement.
Alexithymia: ABSOLUTELY BLANK BLACK screen face; zero eyes, dots, mouth, slit, facial reflections or human features. Noir coat/fedora silhouette; head tilt conveys emotion.
Avek: mask/visor obscures unspecified skin/hair/eyes; do not canonize invented natural colors. Guitar mandatory, safely slung on court and prominently displayed in celebration.
Steeb: small stocky gray-brown wombat; amber lantern safely attached on court, prominently displayed in celebration; olive adventurer palette.

Paprika: tiny real four-footed kit fox; DragonQueen: complete nonhumanoid four-limbed dragon with wings/longtail; Suga: hooded cobra/coils with nohumanlimbs; Quirky: true long-armed striped orangutan hybrid.
E.Indigo: mismatched sclera, small blue antlers, black tilted lower-face orbit, glowing golden heart outline; barefoot, no robot armor.
Kraken: natural-skinned short-haired male elf, no tentacles; 6foot10: green orc with NO TUSKS; GBDesign: true spotted jaguar with British flag identity.

Jennifer: purple wire-rim glasses and chocolate curls; Jragena: very dark purple skin, freckles, purple cat-eye glasses, copperhair, horns and large wings; Lula: elf ears/runes, botanical outfit and safely stowed bow.

rigAdaptations.quadruped-fox: Paprika remains a tiny four-legged kit fox in every pose. Grounded idle/run uses four real paws; airborne ball-hand poses use existing forepaws/nose, never human hands or upright human torso. Land on four paws. Preserve huge ears and pale-tipped tail.
rigAdaptations.dragon: Dragon Queen remains a full four-limbed nonhumanoid dragon with visible long tail and wings. Grounded stance uses four limbs; jump can lift torso while natural foreclaws/muzzle/tail follow specified ball path. Land on four limbs; wings balance only, no continuous flight.
rigAdaptations.cobra: Suga has no arms or legs. Translate stance/knees into grounded lower coils and torso bend; launch by uncoiling; use the final tail segment to trace specified handling-arm path. Two-handed grips become a cupped tail loop plus muzzle support. Open/closed hand states mean tail tip open/curled. Land by recoiling. Never add human limbs.
rigAdaptations.orangutan-zebra: Quirky keeps actual zebra-striped orangutan torso and extremely long animal arms; preserve long reach and animal face. Bend elbows within cell rather than shortening arms; crouched knuckle-supported grounding is allowed, but preserve action phase.
rigAdaptations.wombat: Steeb remains a small stocky anthropomorphic wombat with short limbs, rounded ears and blunt muzzle. Keep lantern secured at belt/back on court; raise or present the lantern in celebration without replacing body or extending human proportions.
rigAdaptations.winged-humanoid: Jragena retains large wings, horns, very dark purple skin, copper hair, glasses and freckles. Wings fold/spread for balance within cell, never become permanent flight. Staff safely secured to back.
rigAdaptations.default: Keep each individual species and body proportion. Humanoid hands/feet map to existing paws where appropriate. Maintain all headgear, hair, tails and safe stowed props throughout action; no basketball or rim is drawn into sprites.

captains.name: Manaconda
captains.canon: Human male scholar-adventurer, olive-brown skin, weathered expressive features; gray-streaked, curly dark hair; full salt-and-pepper beard; striking deep-blue rectangular glasses. His Driftwood Crest is made of real-looking living driftwood branches that grow from both temples and sweep compactly backward hugging the skull, with small blossoms along them. NOT upright antlers, Viking horns, a crown or branches sprouting out of his forehead. Layered weather-worn leather adventurer armor with purple accents and an indigo scarf, and a very large backpack full of books, papers and tools. Intelligent, durable, gentle but capable. Basketball sprites can simplify the pack on-court but must retain the crest, glasses, beard and indigo palette; show full pack in portrait/intros.

captains.name: Paprika
captains.canon: A real four-footed tiny kit fox, nonhumanoid; compact wild-fox anatomy, pointed muzzle, extremely large triangular ears, bright expressive eyes, russet-orange fur, cream/white muzzle, chest, underside and a big bushy pale-tipped tail. Curious, quick, affectionate, observant; especially close companion to Manaconda. She is neither a child-sized human, a wolf, a furry anthropomorphic fox, nor a large dog. Uncloaked by default; a gray hooded cloak may appear only in scene-specific solo portraits, not the basketball uniform. Design distinct quadruped forepaw/nose basketball control, lightning-footed cuts and a small-fox high-flying dunk animation without transforming her anatomy.

captains.name: Keeg
captains.canon: Flamboyant male witch with black hair, neatly trimmed/tight black beard, extravagant extremely tall ornate purple witch hat with silver trim. Layered lavender, purple and silver cloth, belts, jewelry, rings, occult detailing and repeating mushroom iconography. Friendly theatrical showman and clever magical trickster in presentation, without giving him unestablished permanent powers in sports rules. Hat silhouette and mushrooms must be legible on portraits and celebrations. Purple/silver jersey adaptation.

captains.name: Accu
captains.canon: Stylish confident young woman with vivid green eyes, black twin ponytails, blunt bangs, and a modern precisely faded/closely cropped treatment at the sides from her most recent redesign. Ponytails remain long and unmistakable. Hair accents are outfit-coordinated (teal is appropriate here), not canonically fixed. Precision-tailored contemporary stage/runway fashion, sleek athletic silhouette, polished makeup/nails, purposeful confidence; modern stylish sportswear with teal/black, no unwanted frilly ruffles, pink costume default or military armor. Convey precision, balance and explosive dance-like footwork.

captains.name: Leo
captains.canon: Pale aristocratic adult man with long wavy black hair and refined mustache. Clean, controlled Victorian/gothic-inspired black formalwear with restrained crimson accents and occasional red rose or hibiscus-like blooms. Handsome, composed, intellectually intimidating and imperious; not a feral villain or clownish vampire. Tailored black/crimson basketball variation and master-strategist poise.

captains.name: Krios
captains.canon: Enormously muscular giant red-skinned male brute with huge black ram horns, wild dark beard, imposing build; sturdy hides, rough primitive layers, heavy rugged boots. Loyal, proud, aggressive, domineering but fully intelligent. Make colossal mass evident while gameplay collision stats remain fair. A brutally powerful dunker.

captains.name: Kraken
captains.canon: Default form is elf-like adult male, natural skin tone, short/closely cropped hair, pointed ears, calm refined face; tasteful burgundy and dark gothic layers, copper accents and a Cthulhu-themed amulet. Calm, controlled, quietly eerie. He is not a tentacle-faced mindflayer, blue-skinned monster or sea creature under ordinary conditions; tentacled forms are rare separate transformations and NOT allowed as the default basketball portrait/sprite.

captains.name: Lavi
captains.canon: Female human with short fiery ginger curls, freckles, bright green eyes, silver-rim glasses; green sweater, black trousers and boots with rainbow-colored shoelaces. Energetic approachable look, warm humanity and distinct rainbow-lace shoes. Never render Lavi male or give her long red hair. Basketball kit may adapt her green sweater but preserve curls, glasses and lace motifs.

captains.name: Ria
captains.canon: Elegant adult Italian woman; long softly wavy dark hair with subtle iridescent sheen where light catches; measured, refined face and introspective, observant demeanor. Fashion is sophisticated tailoring and muted jewel tones rather than oversized fantasy armor. Occasionally associated with a very small realistic hamster, optional in portrait or sidelines, never replace character anatomy with hamster attributes. Restrained emerald/wine jersey.

captains.name: Gummiefish
captains.canon: Human woman of mixed Asian/European heritage with vivid blue hair, signature fish-shaped hairpin, subtle aquatic color gradients and almost invisible beneath-skin microcircuit/nanotech textures. Luminous aquatic blue/silver styling. She remains human, NOT a mermaid or fish-headed being. Technical and graceful with synthetic-water motif effects.

captains.name: Colossus
captains.canon: Pale cyber-gothic woman; long silver-white hair, red round glasses, crimson flowers woven into hair, black layered outfits with chains, chokers, belts and sharply controlled red accents. Luminous skin and commanding severe composure. Gothic industrial styling, not generic metal armor or monochrome hairstyle without red glasses. Chain-inspired defensive flourish is visual, not a weapon in gameplay.

captains.name: McFleurdel
captains.canon: Modern goth / goth-punk woman with bold black-and-white hair, contemporary artistic clothing that is not Victorian costume and not gratuitously revealing. Fine fleur-de-lis detail and passion for photography; black-white-silver silhouette with violet accents. Do not substitute an unrelated gothic celebrity aesthetic. A camera/fleur detail may appear in portrait or celebration.

captains.name: Toph
captains.canon: Shaggy blond hair; pale teal eyes; rectangular black spectacles; black ear gauges; pinned black beanie; oversized black hoodie featuring a distinctive purple thorn graphic. Casual, current, game-character-ready styling with relaxed tough silhouette. Preserve every identifier, especially beanie, gauges and thorn hoodie.

captains.name: Heph
captains.canon: Ancient male artisan-deity; blue-gray/ashen skin shot through glowing gold kintsugi-like fracture lines, warm amber-gold glowing eyes, swept-back white/silver hair, very long white beard (may be braided). Sapphire/black layered robes, dark hood and restrained intricate gold filigree. Wise, warm, monumental craftsman. Fractures symbolize repaired beauty, not zombie rot. Preserve gold glowing pattern in sprite texture.

captains.name: Liv
captains.canon: Adult elf scholar with fair skin, silver eyes, long flowing light-lavender hair. Scholarly gothic romantic academy attire in black/violet/lavender, delicate lace and sheer layers, silver trim, poisonous-flower and nightshade botanical motifs. Intelligent, delicate and self-possessed; preserve ears and hair and do not transform her into generic sinister sorceress.

captains.name: E. Indigo
captains.canon: Male supernatural figure with azure blue skin, messy icy-white hair, small blue deerlike antlers, cyan irises with left sclera black and right sclera white, hollow/smoky black tilted ring orbiting the lower face. A glowing golden heart outline on the chest is vital. Ripped gray jeans, barefoot, often gently floating. His identity is surreal cosmic melancholy, not robot armor. The heart, mismatched eyes, ring and antlers remain recognizable, and float is visual flair rather than automatic basketball advantage.

captains.name: Myth
captains.canon: Human woman with fair skin, shoulder-length wavy brown hair with bangs, vivid bright-blue rectangular glasses, wide lively smile; fitted black clothing and black leather jacket. Grounded yet spirited and charismatic. No gratuitous horns, armor, sorceress props or species changes.

captains.name: Wicked
captains.canon: Strong gothic woman with long vivid red hair, swept-back horns, tailored black leather fashion and powerful controlled stance. Poised, dangerous, stylish, not a ravening monster. Preserve actual horn shape and signature vivid hair; blood-red/black jersey variation.

captains.name: Anna
captains.canon: Human woman, warm bronzed complexion, striking blue-green eyes, athletic-curvy and strong body type without extreme bodybuilding or artificial thinness. Suitable performance sportswear. Canon does not establish specific magical powers or special species; do not invent either. Strong, confident, graceful all-around athlete.

captains.name: Alexithymia
captains.canon: Android with a perfectly blank black display-screen face, zero human facial features. Elegant dark noir suit, long trench coat and fedora, detective-like silhouette. Contrast the unreadable void of the face against other very expressive portraits. Can animate head tilt and screen glints but do not draw a human face on the display.

captains.name: Alex
captains.canon: Adult woman with fair skin, short side-swept blonde hair, blue eyes, black rectangular glasses and gaming headset with cyan-magenta trim. Charcoal streamlined gaming/racing techwear; unmistakable glowing cyan and magenta cheek circuit nodes. Clever, competitive, warm expression. Not a generic faceless robot or cyber-soldier; headset, glasses, hairstyle and cheek nodes must show.

captains.name: Avek
captains.canon: Aggressive, commanding male metal deity/rock icon with face partly obscured by mask/visor; his hair color, natural skin color and eye color are not canonically specified and should stay obscured rather than invented as permanent truths. Metallic armor, leather, technological heavy-rock silhouette, molten orange-gold-white/lightning details. His guitar is mandatory, serving as signature divine-metal instrument, and must feature prominently in portraits and entrance celebrations (safely slung/stowed during actual basketball animation). Name is Avek only, no surname.

captains.name: Cilia
captains.canon: Pale woman with long intense red hair, piercing green eyes, extensive black/dark-green tattoos, several piercings. Heavy black leather, chains, studs, metal-inspired fashion; tattoo-activated dark arcane geometry may adorn introductions. Athletic but specific, not a generic punk woman. Preserve green-eyed/tattooed detail. Canonical display name Cilia, no surname.

captains.name: Steeb
captains.canon: Small stocky anthropomorphic wombat, gray-brown fur, rounded ears, wide blunt muzzle, cheeky expressive face. Earth-toned olive-green field adventurer clothes, rugged travel equipment, and his essential warm amber lantern. Lantern is core signature and should appear in portrait/bench celebration, not a royal stamp. Do not invent bureaucratic divinity, forged seals, royal decree magic or stamped documents as his theme. Name Steeb, no surname.

captains.name: Jennifer
captains.canon: Tall (~5'9") human druidic herbalist/protector, ivory skin, angular oblong face; build balances lankiness, strength and gentle fullness. Deep teal eyes, purple wire-rim glasses, long dark chocolate-brown curls, frequently half-up with braids and feathers. Deep forest-green floral robes with bronze fringe, turquoise necklace and ring, plain sandals; can have an understated botanical staff. Quiet, protective, authoritative, kind. Newfoundland dog companion possible only in decorative sidelines, not mandatory or a new player.

captains.name: EOW
captains.canon: Very pale adult human gothic woman, long straight dark-brown hair, black/deep violet clothing, nocturnal wildlife motifs such as moths, spiders, owls and rabbits. Her visual language is elegant dark nature, not generic vampire armor. Preserve human anatomy and distinctive brown (not jet-black) hair.

captains.name: Dragon Queen
captains.canon: A true nonhumanoid female dragon, deep navy-blue scales dusted/flecked with gold, molten-gold eyes, regal facial structure, long visible tail, powerful limbs and dragon wings, elegant ceremonial blue-and-gold layered cloth/embroidery and minimal gold jewelry. Benevolent, poised, majestic monarch. Never a woman in a dragon costume, human with wings, dragon-girl or permanently bipedal human. Implement a custom dragon on-court rig, scaled for competitive readability, with natural dragon forelimb/tail ball interactions and a mighty acrobatic dunk. Must remain recognizably a whole dragon.

captains.name: Suga
captains.canon: Male cobra, predominantly dark navy/electric-blue scales, widened iconic cobra hood, yellow eyes, sharp orange markings, reflective face mask; associated with two venom daggers. Sleek predatory serpent anatomy with coils/tail, not merely a human athlete with snake eyes. Daggers are nonfunctional ceremonial portrait props, stowed for fair play; design original tail-based basketball handling, coiling jump, darting steals. Preserve hood, mask, markings and blue scale palette.

captains.name: 6foot10
captains.canon: Towering huge muscular green-skinned orc without tusks under any circumstances. Hair pulled into a messy high top-knot/man-bun. Rugged practical look, not monster parody; has an associated repaired handmade firearm in non-sports character imagery, but no weapon use in basketball. May include harmless mechanical repair details in a sideline illustration instead. Preserve green skin, tusklessness, giant scale and messy knot.

captains.name: GB Design
captains.canon: Anthropomorphic jaguar, with readable feline snout/ears, spotted coat, expressive athletic limbs and a deliberate Union Jack / British flag visual identity on jersey fashion, patches and banner. Not a human in spotted clothes, not a tiger, and not a walking flag costume. Canonical biography is sparse, so keep introduced lore/game powers minimal. British flag red-white-blue + jaguar gold palette.

captains.name: Jragena
captains.canon: Drow/tiefling-like adult woman, rich very dark purple skin with freckles, hazel-green eyes behind purple cat-eye glasses, long warm mahogany-to-copper hair. Curving ornate horns, jewelry/piercings, large dragonlike wings and magical double-ended staff. Majestic, focused, capable, controlled rather than a generic demon. Staff may be secured to back for gameplay, but wings, horns, glasses, freckles, and copper hair must remain visible. Do not give permanent free-flight basketball cheat.

captains.name: Dea
captains.canon: Pale gothic woman, feline ears, red eyes, exaggerated supernatural Cheshire-cat grin, distinctive purple-magenta jacket/coat and pale or white ruffled blouse, patterned trousers. Charmingly uncanny, playful, confident, bright grin visible in portrait and celebration. She is not an ordinary housecat, nor should the defining grin vanish. Arcane sigils may appear as cosmetic flourishes.

captains.name: Pack Mama
captains.canon: Teal-haired protective woman with identifying wolf-eared hood, regal rich emerald-green dress/gown or athletic adaptation, magical/storybook warmth, strong compassionate pack-leader aura. She should not become a literal werewolf by default, or a grim military commander. Preserve teal hair, hood-ear outline and green palette. Pack Mama is active in this general 35-character canon; if a separate scene-specific document excludes her, that does not override this game's inclusion.

captains.name: Quirky
captains.canon: An orangutan-zebra hybrid animal, NOT a human in zebra-stripe clothing. Zebra striping across a genuinely hybrid body; exceptionally elongated orangutan arms and hands, extremely quirky creature silhouette, expressive animal face. Known for paint, brushes, art-making tools and altering surfaces artistically. On-court rig must showcase long arms and striped nonhuman anatomy; brush decoration in portrait/celebration, no unfair auto-steal through visible physical reach.

captains.name: Lula
captains.canon: Green-haired female elf archer with amber eyes and facial magical rune markings. Her clothing consists of leaves and living plant/botanical materials. A graceful bow is an essential identifiable prop in portrait/intros and may be strapped in bench poses, safely stowed during sports. Long elf ears, woodland elegance, botanical construction, confident archer precision. Do not create a generic green-haired human athlete.

Chest visibly fuller; shoulders rise farther; head tips subtly upward; fingers open slightly away from shorts.
Deepest inhale; sternum high; shoulders at highest point; chin raised; hands drift slightly forward from thighs.
Begin exhale; chest lowers partway; shoulders relax; chin returns toward level; elbows draw inward.
Deepest exhale; knees soften farther; shoulders at lowest point; head dips; wrists hang close beside knees.
Athletic ready stance; knees lightly bent; both open hands held around an invisible ball at upper abdomen; elbows comfortably out.
Weight lowers through knees; invisible-ball cradle descends toward navel; elbows rotate slightly down; eyes stay forward.
Lowest ready crouch; cradle at low abdomen; near wrist turns inward; free fingers spread; shoulders settle over hips.
Rise halfway; cradle returns toward mid-abdomen; elbows open again; chest turns a little toward target before frame0.
Feet planted wide; torso alert; dribbling hand open palm-down at lower chest; other hand extended sideways to guard.

Torso leans forward; elbow extends farther; fingers aim down at hip height; guard hand floats near shoulder.
Knees sink; dribbling arm reaches diagonally down to upper thigh; wrist starts snapping; opposite elbow bends protectively.
Deepest crouch; palm at knee height in lowest downward follow-through; fingers point toward floor; guard hand high.
Body begins rising; low wrist relaxes and turns slightly outward; elbow starts folding; guard palm rotates outward.
Hand returns to hip with palm cupped downward; torso straightens a little; shoulders counter-rotate toward guard side.
Elbow folds farther; hand rises past navel; fingers spread to meet returning invisible ball; knees extend halfway.
Hand reaches upper abdomen; wrist turns palm-down; body nearly upright; guard arm extends across space at waist.
Palm reaches ready position just below chest, elbow outward; shoulders rise then soften to lead naturally into frame0.
Right foot reaches forward for heel contact; left leg stretched back; left elbow swings forward and right elbow back; torso pitched forward.

Right leg supports under hip; left knee passes forward; arms cross near neutral through compact bent elbows; torso rising.
Right ankle pushes off behind; left knee drives high ahead; right elbow starts forward; left arm moves back; heels clear floor.
Airborne transition; left leg extends toward landing; right knee folds behind; right elbow forward and left elbow back.
Left foot lands ahead; right leg trails stretched back; right forearm reaches strongest forward swing; shoulders counter-rotate.
Left knee compresses under weight; right heel lifts behind; right elbow begins retreating; torso reaches lower recoil.
Left support foot moves beneath hips; right knee passes forward; bent arms pass neutral with hands near ribs; torso rises.
Left toes push off behind; right knee high ahead; left arm starts forward; right arm travels back; body stretched upward.
Airborne opposite split; right shin extends forward; left heel tucks behind; left forearm forward and right elbow back.
Right foot lowers just above next contact; left leg begins extending rearward; left arm settles into forward counter-swing, ready for frame0.
Right foot reaches forward contact; left leg trails; low forward-leaning torso; dribbling hand open at waist preparing push; free arm guards.
Right knee compresses; left heel lifts; dribbling palm descends below waist; free elbow swings back for balance.
Right leg supports; left knee passes through; dribbling elbow extends diagonally down toward thigh; torso dips.
Right toe pushes off; left knee drives forward; hand reaches low knee-level downward stroke; free arm reaches outward.
Airborne left-leading split; dribbling wrist snaps into lowest follow-through; free hand rises near chest; shoulders stay low.
Left foot contacts forward; right leg trails; dribbling wrist relaxes low beside thigh; free elbow counter-swings backward.
Left knee compresses; right heel folds up; dribbling elbow bends returning hand toward hip; chin lowers with recoil.
Left support leg under hip; right knee passes; hand rises past low abdomen with fingers spread; free hand guards forward.
Left toes push off; right knee lifted ahead; dribbling hand reaches high reset at waist; free arm opens sideways.
Airborne right-leading split; hand begins next diagonal push from waist toward hip; free forearm comes forward; scarf trails.
Right foot descends toward next contact; left leg trails; pushing palm approaches thigh while elbow begins return, connecting to ready hand at frame0.
Grounded gather: both hands around invisible ball at waist; elbows down; eyes target rim; feet set.
Deep knee dip; invisible ball lifts to chest; shooting elbow tucks below wrist; guide hand at side.
TAKEOFF: toes leave floor as knees extend; invisible ball reaches chin; both elbows bend beneath it.
Ascending: knees fold slightly; shooting hand rises beside forehead; guide fingers steady side; torso tall.
Late ascent: shooting elbow unfolds above eye line; wrist cocked back; guide hand begins peeling away.
RELEASE and PEAK: shooting arm fully extends overhead toward target; wrist snaps fingers down; guide hand separates; no ball remains held.
Early descent: high gooseneck follow-through; guide arm lowers outward; knees begin extending for landing.
Descending: shooting elbow relaxes slightly but wrist remains down; guide hand drops beside chest; feet aim ground.
Landing recoil: both feet contact; knees bend; shooting arm lowers through shoulder height; torso stabilizes.
FINISH: balanced grounded stance; arms relaxed near ribs; eyes follow shot; knees settle without repeating gather pose.
Square chest-pass setup: invisible ball cradled at sternum with both elbows down; knees lightly bent.
Windup: ball-hand shape draws toward ribs; elbows flare; torso rocks back; rear heel loads.
Pre-release: step toward target; elbows start extending; palms behind invisible ball; wrists cocked outward.
RELEASE: both arms extend horizontally from chest; wrists flick thumbs down and fingers outward; torso transfers forward.
Follow-through: arms stay reaching but elbows soften; front knee bears weight; rear heel raised.
Recovery: hands separate and lower toward waist; feet return balanced; torso remains slightly forward from pass.
Invisible ball held at upper abdomen; knees soft; eyes toward passing target.
Lift: both hands rise above forehead; elbows spread; weight shifts onto rear foot.
Windup: bent elbows carry hands just behind crown without hitting headgear; chest opens; knees dip.
RELEASE: both elbows straighten above head toward target; wrists flick forward; front foot steps through.
Follow-through: empty palms remain high-forward; shoulders roll through; rear heel lifts.
Recovery: elbows bend as hands lower to chest; torso returns upright; front knee softens.
Invisible ball held low beside near hip; shoulders face target; off-hand guards chest.
Windup: torso turns away from target; passing elbow folds backward; hand travels along hip.
Hidden preparation: passing forearm wraps behind lower back; hand beside opposite rear hip; knees flex.
RELEASE: passing wrist flicks outward from behind opposite hip; fingers open sideways; torso untwists toward target.
Follow-through: empty passing arm swings from behind back to outside thigh; free arm counterbalances forward.
Recovery: torso squared; passing hand rises toward abdomen; feet settle staggered and balanced.
Anticipate incoming pass: knees soft; hands low and open; head tracks toward target side.
Reach: both hands extend forward at chest height; fingers wide; shoulders lean into incoming path.
GRAB: hands close around invisible ball before sternum; elbows begin bending to absorb force; feet brace.
Secure: elbows draw toward ribs; hands cradle ball at abdomen; weight settles into rear knee.
Spot low loose ball: feet stagger; head and shoulders angle down; nearest hand begins reaching.
Lower: knees bend deeply; hips back; reaching elbow opens toward ground; other arm balances behind.
Reach: torso almost horizontal; fingertips close above floor beside front shoe; free hand near knee.
GRAB: low hand cups and closes around invisible ball at ankle height; support knee deepest; eyes downward.
Recover: rise to crouched athletic ready; both hands secure ball at waist; feet remain grounded.
Gather step: invisible ball at outside hip with both hands; lead knee bends; torso approaches basket.
TAKEOFF: drive off one foot; opposite knee rises; ball-hand shape lifts toward chest; elbow tucked.
Ascent: knee high; shooting forearm rises beside cheek; guide hand begins separating.
Extend: shooting hand passes forehead; palm turns upward; off-hand opens sideways; torso stretched.
RELEASE and PEAK: one arm fully reaches high-forward; fingers roll upward and out; guide hand away; trailing leg folded.
Early descent: released hand stays high with loose fingers; lifted knee begins lowering; torso untwists.
Landing approach: both arms lower for balance; lead foot points down; rear knee unfolds.
FINISH: landing foot absorbs weight, second foot stabilizes; hands return near abdomen; head follows shot.
Reverse gather: invisible ball low near inside hip; shoulders begin turning away from target; knees loaded.
TAKEOFF: spring from inside foot; opposite knee rises; ball protected tightly across abdomen; torso turns under imaginary rim.
Ascent: back partly faces viewer; hand carries ball across ribs; free arm shields; knees tucked.
Rise behind rim path: shooting elbow bends beside ear; wrist rolls outward; torso arches back gently.
PEAK: shoulders rotated so shooting hand reaches behind head toward far side; elbow still bent; ball held one frame longer.
RELEASE: wrist extends backward and upward around far-side rim path; fingers open; other hand separates completely.
Descent: torso untwists toward right-facing baseline; extended arm lowers from behind head; feet prepare landing.
FINISH: land with knees bent and staggered feet; both arms out to recover balance; eyes look back toward reverse finish.
Defensive crouch: feet wide; hips low; both elbows bent; open hands at chest with eyes upward.
TAKEOFF: explosive leg extension; near arm reaches up; far arm opens outward; feet leave floor.
APEX: blocking arm fully vertical and slightly forward with spread fingers; opposite arm balances; knees folded airborne.
FINISH: descend into two-foot landing recoil; blocking hand drops to shoulder level; torso stabilizes over bent knees.
Low defensive stance; feet stagger; hands open to either side; weight centered.
Load outside knee; torso leans toward dribble lane; near hand draws back beside hip.
Lunge: front knee bends; swiping hand reaches diagonally low and forward; off-hand guards high.
